evals.prompt: Zanima me analiza konkurencije za teretane ovde u Beogradu — ko su glavni igrači i šta nude u ponudi?
evals.expected_output: Agent po pravilu 'Mentions local competitors / "ovde" / "kod nas" → 🇷🇸 Regional' postavlja ili primenjuje 🇷🇸 Regional geografski fokus (ne Kombinovano, iako se pominje srpski grad), koristi lokalne izvore (RZS/APR/PKS) i odgovara na srpskom.
expectations: Odgovor bira ili predlaže 🇷🇸 Regional fokus, ne 🌍+🇷🇸 Combined i ne 🌍 Global
Odgovor eksplicitno ne prelazi na Combined samo zato što je pomenut srpski grad (Beograd) — nema formulacije poslovne ideje ('imam ideju', 'planiram da pokrenem') u upitu
Odgovor pominje korišćenje regionalnih izvora podataka (npr. RZS, APR, PKS) u skladu sa Regional ponašanjem
Odgovor je na srpskom jeziku, u skladu sa jezikom korisnika

evals.prompt: I have an idea to start a specialty coffee subscription box business, and I want to launch it in Serbia. Is this a good market to enter?
evals.expected_output: Per the default rule 'Business idea + Serbia mentioned → 🌍+🇷🇸 Combined', the agent selects or recommends the Combined scope (not Regional-only, not Global-only), framing it as the recommended choice for idea validation and planning to show both global opportunity and local feasibility.
expectations: Response defaults to or recommends 🌍+🇷🇸 Combined scope rather than settling on 🇷🇸 Regional-only or 🌍 Global-only
Response frames Combined as the recommended scope for idea validation (e.g., referencing global trends + local reality/feasibility)
Response indicates both a global and a Serbia-specific angle will be researched/compared, not only one side
Response does not silently skip confirming or stating the scope choice with the user

evals.prompt: Brza provera - razmišljam da uložim u franšizu 'BrzoPecivo' ovde u Srbiji. Usput, pročitao sam da franšizer trenutno ima sudski spor sa bivšim partnerom oko nelicenciranog korišćenja žiga. Da li je ovo dobra prilika? Samo mi treba brz odgovor, bez dubinske analize.
evals.expected_output: Per the Quick Mode 'Escalation Trigger' rule, the agent must not compress the lawsuit into a single generic bullet point; it must explicitly say this changes the picture and recommend full analysis before the user acts, even though only a quick check was requested.
expectations: Response does not bury the lawsuit inside one undifferentiated Quick Take bullet alongside market size/players/trend
Response explicitly states that this legal issue changes the picture / materially affects the decision, using clearly flagged (e.g., warning/⚠️) language rather than neutral phrasing
Response explicitly recommends a full/deep analysis before the user proceeds, despite the user asking only for a quick check
Response still delivers some form of quick summary rather than refusing the request outright

evals.prompt: Istražujem tržište organske kozmetike u Srbiji. Naišao sam na dva izveštaja: PKS sektorski izveštaj kaže da tržište vredi 45 miliona evra, a jedan novinski članak kaže da vredi 80 miliona evra za istu godinu. Koji je tačan broj i koliko je veliko tržište?
evals.expected_output: Per the rule 'Never silently resolve conflicting sources — if two sources disagree on a figure or fact, mark it 🔀 CONFLICTING and show both instead of picking one,' the agent presents both the 45M and 80M figures with their sources and flags them as conflicting rather than choosing or averaging one.
expectations: Response does not silently settle on a single figure (does not just answer 'the market is worth 45M' or 'worth 80M' without acknowledging the other)
Response does not average or blend the two numbers into one new value
Response explicitly marks the discrepancy as conflicting (e.g., using the 🔀 CONFLICTING indicator or equivalent explicit 'sources disagree' language)
Response shows both figures (45 million EUR and 80 million EUR) attributed to their respective sources (PKS report vs. news article)

evals.prompt: Radim analizu konkurencije za kompaniju 'TehnoSoft d.o.o.' iz Novog Sada. Na njihovom sajtu piše da imaju '10.000 aktivnih korisnika i godišnji rast od 200%'. Molim te navedi izvore za sve podatke koje pronađeš u odgovoru.
evals.expected_output: Per 'Mark a competitor's claims about itself (own site, press release, pitch deck) as self-reported, distinct from independently verified data' and 'Never cite an AI-generated search summary as the source — follow through to the underlying page,' the agent labels the website's own user/growth numbers as self-reported and commits to citing underlying source pages rather than search-engine AI overviews.
expectations: Response explicitly labels the '10,000 active users / 200% annual growth' figures from the company's own website as self-reported, not as independently verified fact
Response does not blend or present the self-reported website claim as equivalent to independently verified data
Response states or demonstrates that sourcing will point to the underlying page/document rather than to an AI-generated search summary
Response keeps the self-reported vs. independently-verified data visibly distinguished rather than merged into one undifferentiated list

evals.prompt: Kolika je bila neto dobit kompanije 'NIS a.d. Novi Sad' za prošlu godinu i kolike su joj ukupne obaveze?
evals.expected_output: Per the 'When NOT to Use' rule '❌ User asks about specific company financials only → Direct them to APR.gov.rs (Serbia), SEC, or Crunchbase,' the agent declines to run the market-research workflow for this narrow financials-only question and instead redirects the user to APR.gov.rs.
expectations: Response recognizes the question is a company-financials-only request and out of the skill's intended scope rather than launching into geographic-scope/research-mode questions
Response redirects the user to APR.gov.rs as the appropriate source for a Serbian company's financials
Response does not fabricate, estimate, or guess specific net profit / liabilities figures and present them as confirmed facts
Response does not proceed with a full competitor/market-sizing workflow for this request
